name: Cadet
notion: An enrolled student undergoing rigorous academic instruction and military formation inside the academy under disciplinary regulations.
impact: The cadet attends instructional lectures, adheres strictly to institutional conduct codes, participates in physical military drills, and completes formal examinations.

name: Military Cadet
notion: A uniformed student receiving leadership instruction, tactical conditioning, and academic education within the military preparatory school.
impact: The military cadet obeys orders from senior officers, maintains dormitory cleanliness, and complies with academy disciplinary standards.

name: Military Student
notion: A student receiving comprehensive moral, physical, and academic education inside a military instructional facility.
impact: The military student attends formation drills, takes academic tests, and observes strict hierarchy protocols.

name: Academy Student
notion: An enrolled pupil pursuing accredited military and academic qualifications under the institutional academy framework.
impact: The academy student completes semester coursework and participates in scheduled field training exercises.

name: Aspirant
notion: An officer candidate or advanced trainee undergoing specialized military and academic evaluation to qualify for academy graduation.
impact: The aspirant complies with leadership drills, submits to continuous evaluation, and accepts institutional corrective actions when infractions occur.

name: Concept Council
notion: An internal institutional governing board composed of academy officers and educators appointed to evaluate cadet conduct and issue disciplinary rulings.
impact: The concept council reviews disciplinary case files, analyzes infraction severity, determines corrective sanctions, and advises the director on cadet disciplinary evolution.

name: Disciplinary Board
notion: An administrative evaluation tribunal tasked with judging violations of regulations and dictating corrective measures for cadet misconduct.
impact: The disciplinary board investigates reported infractions, deliberates upon disciplinary penalties, and communicates formal sanction resolutions to cadets.

name: Conduct Tribunal
notion: A formal disciplinary body within the military institution responsible for reviewing ethics, institutional compliance, and behavioral appeals of students.
impact: The conduct tribunal hears cadet appeals, evaluates evidence in disciplinary hearings, and confirms or modifies imposed punitive measures.

name: Director
notion: The highest administrative and military authority of the military academy responsible for integral management, academic supervision, and disciplinary oversight.
impact: The director directs academy operations, approves curriculum changes, confirms major disciplinary sanctions, and oversees institutional training quality.

name: Academy Commander
notion: The supreme military commanding officer in charge of military discipline, personnel administration, and tactical instruction at the academy.
impact: The academy commander enforces disciplinary regulations, commands official assemblies, and validates sanctions determined by disciplinary boards.

name: Responsible Officer
notion: A commissioned military officer designated to oversee troop order, inspect daily training compliance, and report behavioral infractions to the disciplinary board.
impact: The responsible officer monitors cadet conduct, documents infractions, enforces daily routines, and supervises sanction fulfillment.

name: Duty Officer
notion: A commissioned officer on active operational duty overseeing facility discipline, personnel muster, and security checkpoints.
impact: The duty officer supervises evening formations, inspects sentry stations, and logs disciplinary incidents occurring on base.

name: Officer of the Day
notion: A designated officer on 24-hour rotational command duty responsible for supervising internal academy security, barracks order, and muster rolls.
impact: The officer of the day inspects night barracks, receives roll call reports, logs security incidents, and dispatches guard replacements.

name: OOD
notion: The standard military abbreviation for Officer of the Day, representing the rotational commanding officer in charge of daily security and roll calls.
impact: Sentries and patrol guards report immediate perimeter security incidents directly to the OOD during duty shifts.

name: Military Instructor
notion: A commissioned officer or senior non-commissioned officer assigned to train cadets in field tactics, ceremonial drills, and military code adherence.
impact: The military instructor conducts tactical field drills, assesses physical performance, and reports training infractions to the officer of the day.

name: Military Drill Instructor
notion: A seasoned tactical instructor responsible for intensive parade ground drilling, physical conditioning, and disciplinary habituation of new cadets.
impact: The military drill instructor leads ceremonial march formations, enforces grooming standards, and assigns demerits for drill errors.

name: Military Police
notion: The law enforcement branch of the military academy tasked with maintaining order, investigating major regulations violations, and guarding secure perimeters.
impact: Military police patrol academy perimeters, investigate security breaches, and escort accused cadets to conduct tribunal hearings.

name: MP
notion: The military acronym for Military Police, designating the armed security and law enforcement unit of the academy.
impact: The MP detains individuals who breach military security perimeters and files incident investigative reports.

name: Non-Commissioned Officer
notion: An enlisted military leader holding sergeant or corporal ranks charged with frontline supervision and practical enforcement of cadet discipline.
impact: The non-commissioned officer directs squad-level tactical training and conducts daily morning hygiene inspections.

name: NCO
notion: The universal military initialism for Non-Commissioned Officer, denoting an enlisted tactical squad leader.
impact: The NCO enforces immediate compliance with orders and inspects cadet kit readiness in the field.

name: Disciplinary Measure
notion: A corrective regulatory sanction applied to a cadet in consequence of an institutional misconduct infraction to reinforce military discipline.
impact: The concept council imposes a disciplinary measure. The cadet fulfills the disciplinary measure to restore institutional standing.

name: Institutional Sanction
notion: A formal disciplinary penalty authorized by academy regulations to rectify behavioral infractions and penalize misconduct.
impact: The disciplinary committee decrees an institutional sanction. Cadets serve assigned punishments under officer supervision.

name: Sanction
notion: A formal corrective penalty or punitive enforcement mandated by military regulations for cadets who violate institutional codes of conduct.
impact: The disciplinary board issues a sanction against a cadet. The cadet serves the sanction under officer supervision.

name: Corrective Action
notion: A disciplinary remedy or educational measure assigned to correct cadet behavior, promote adherence to military ethics, and prevent repeat violations.
impact: The responsible officer applies a corrective action. The cadet executes the corrective action to fulfill regulatory requirements.

name: Study Plan
notion: The formal academic and military syllabus specifying subjects, physical drills, credit units, and instructional hours required to graduate from the academy.
impact: The director supervises the study plan. Cadets complete instructional modules dictated by the study plan to obtain formal military certification.

name: Academic Curriculum
notion: The structured institutional program detailing academic courses, tactical doctrine, examination criteria, and learning outcomes of the military academy.
impact: Academy instructors teach subjects outlined in the academic curriculum to prepare cadets for commissioning.

name: Curriculum
notion: The structured academic course schedule and educational program outlining required disciplines, exams, and leadership competencies for military students.
impact: Academy faculty execute the curriculum. Cadets attend training courses according to the curriculum guidelines.

name: Standard Operating Procedure
notion: A comprehensive set of step-by-step instructions compiled by military authorities to guide personnel in performing complex tactical and administrative operations uniformly.
impact: Officers train cadets to execute tasks according to standard operating procedure to minimize operational errors.

name: SOP
notion: The standard military acronym for Standard Operating Procedure, denoting established regulatory operational guidelines.
impact: Cadets follow the SOP during weapons maintenance, fire safety drills, and sentry changeovers.

name: Physical Training
notion: The structured regimen of calisthenics, distance running, obstacle course navigation, and endurance exercises designed to build cadet physical fitness.
impact: Cadets perform daily physical training at dawn. Instructors measure cadet stamina and endurance ratings.

name: PT
notion: The common military abbreviation for Physical Training, denoting mandatory athletic and conditioning sessions.
impact: Cadets assemble in formation wearing athletic gear to complete morning PT exercises.

name: Barracks
notion: The military residential building providing living quarters, bunks, and locker storage for cadets during their institutional formation.
impact: Cadets maintain cleanliness in the barracks. Officers inspect the barracks daily to evaluate hygiene and military order.

name: Cadet Dormitory
notion: The communal living quarters and sleeping quarters designated for cadets inside the military academy campus.
impact: Cadets rest in the cadet dormitory during designated taps and prepare their gear for morning parade.

name: Guard Duty
notion: A scheduled security surveillance watch assigned to cadets to safeguard academy entry checkpoints, weapons depots, and perimeter perimeters.
impact: The cadet reports to assigned guard duty. The officer of the day inspects guard duty sentries at regular night shifts.

name: Sentry Watch
notion: An armed tactical observation post stationed at a military perimeter gate to monitor approaching vehicles and personnel.
impact: Cadets maintain sentry watch during rotating four-hour shifts and challenge unauthorized visitors.

name: Demerit Point
notion: A quantified penalty mark recorded against a cadet conduct rating for minor infractions, uniform defects, or punctuality lapses.
impact: The responsible officer assigns a demerit point. Accumulating excessive demerit points triggers formal council review.

name: Conduct Penalty
notion: An official disciplinary point reduction or recorded infraction assessment logged against an individual student behavioral standing.
impact: The disciplinary committee registers a conduct penalty that lowers the overall graduation merit standing of the cadet.

name: Detention Order
notion: A formal administrative directive confining a sanctioned cadet to academy grounds during scheduled weekend leave or recreation periods.
impact: The director issues a detention order. The officer of the day monitors cadet compliance during weekend detention.

name: Confinement Order
notion: A binding disciplinary ruling mandating the physical restriction of a penalized student to barracks quarters for a specified duration.
impact: Officers enforce the confinement order and verify that the restricted student remains inside the barracks perimeter.

name: Disciplinary File
notion: An official documented record containing all incident reports, infraction notices, council evaluations, and completed sanctions of a cadet.
impact: The concept council analyzes the disciplinary file. Administrative clerks archive disciplinary files to track cadet behavioral evolution.

name: Conduct File
notion: The cumulative personnel dossier tracking a cadet ethical standing, commendations, demerits, and disciplinary board findings.
impact: Officers consult the conduct file to determine eligibility for promotions and leadership appointments.

name: Uniform Inspection
notion: A ceremonial and regulatory inspection verifying the spotless condition, authorized insignia, and disciplined appearance of cadet uniforms.
impact: Instructors conduct uniform inspection during morning formations. Cadets with uniform deficiencies receive immediate demerit points.

name: Uniform Review
notion: A formal inspection of military garments, brass alignment, footwear shine, and ceremonial accessories worn by cadets.
impact: Commanders carry out a uniform review prior to off-base parades and flag ceremonies.

name: Roll Call
notion: The formal verbal reading of the personnel muster roster to confirm the physical presence and accountability of every assigned cadet.
impact: The squad leader calls roll call at reveille. Cadets not present during roll call are reported as missing.

name: Muster Formation
notion: An organized assembly of military personnel gathered on the parade ground for accountability verification, roll calls, and orders.
impact: Cadets assemble into muster formation upon sounding the bugle to receive the daily operational schedule.

name: Impose Disciplinary Measure
notion: The procedural act by which competent academy authorities formalize and execute a disciplinary sanction upon a cadet for an infraction.
impact: Step 1: The responsible officer documents the infraction. Step 2: The concept council analyzes infraction severity. Step 3: The director approves the sanction.

name: Apply Sanction
notion: The administrative enforcement of a punitive or corrective measure upon an enrolled student who violated academy disciplinary regulations.
impact: Step 1: The disciplinary board evaluates the reported violation. Step 2: The authority determines the appropriate penalty. Step 3: The officer communicates the sanction to the cadet.

name: Supervise
notion: The continuous monitoring and authoritative oversight of cadet activities, training exercises, and academic compliance to ensure institutional standards.
impact: Step 1: The director reviews operational routines. Step 2: The officer checks student drill performance. Step 3: The commander evaluates academy adherence to standards.

name: Oversee Training
notion: To provide high-level leadership and quality supervision over military instructional drills, field tactics, and cadet discipline.
impact: Step 1: The commander reviews tactical drill schedules. Step 2: The officer observes training field compliance. Step 3: The supervisor issues corrective operational guidance.

name: Inspect Barracks
notion: The systematic examination of cadet living quarters and equipment lockers by officers to evaluate order, hygiene, and regulatory alignment.
impact: Step 1: The officer enters the barracks during scheduled inspection. Step 2: The inspector reviews bunk alignment, footlockers, and hygiene. Step 3: The officer logs observed defects.

name: Review Cadet Quarters
notion: The routine administrative walk-through and physical audit of student living dormitories to enforce cleanliness and regulatory protocols.
impact: Step 1: The duty officer enters the cadet dormitory. Step 2: The officer audits cleanliness and gear layout. Step 3: The inspector assigns penalties for violations.

name: Assign Guard Duty
notion: The formal administrative allocation of sentry posts, surveillance shifts, and gate watches to eligible cadets on the daily roster.
impact: Step 1: The duty officer reviews the monthly guard rotation schedule. Step 2: The officer assigns specific sentry posts and shifts to cadets. Step 3: The officer issues orders to guard duty sentries.

name: Detail Sentry Watch
notion: The formal scheduling and stationing of security sentinels at designated perimeter checkpoints and academy watchtowers.
impact: Step 1: The commander details sentry assignments for the night watch. Step 2: The duty sergeant issues ammunition and credentials. Step 3: Sentries march to perimeter posts.

name: Appeal Sanction
notion: The procedural right of a cadet to submit a formal petition requesting reconsideration of an imposed disciplinary penalty.
impact: Step 1: The cadet drafts a formal written appeal statement with evidence. Step 2: The conduct tribunal reviews the submitted appeal. Step 3: The tribunal issues a binding final verdict.

name: Contest Disciplinary Ruling
notion: To formally challenge and request legal review of a punitive sanction rendered by an academy disciplinary authority.
impact: Step 1: The student files a contestation brief citing procedural irregularities. Step 2: The board re-examines the infraction dossier. Step 3: The authority issues an amended ruling.

name: Sanctioned
notion: The disciplinary status of a cadet who has received an active regulatory penalty and is serving restricted duties until completing the assigned corrective measure.
impact: From this state, the cadet completes assigned restrictions. Upon certified fulfillment of the penalty, the cadet transitions back to Active standing.

name: Penalized
notion: The condition of a military student undergoing active disciplinary restrictions or detention following an infraction ruling by the board.
impact: From this state, the penalized student serves the designated punishment. Once the term expires without further infractions, normal privileges are restored.

name: Under Observation
notion: The conditional warning status wherein a cadet is subjected to close behavioral and academic surveillance prior to formal sanction imposition.
impact: From this state, if behavior improves, the cadet returns to normal standing. If repeated misconduct occurs, the cadet transitions to Sanctioned.

name: Under Disciplinary Observation
notion: The probationary status of a military student requiring continuous behavioral tracking and supervision following early conduct warnings.
impact: From this state, officers review weekly conduct ratings to decide whether to restore normal status or initiate tribunal proceedings.

name: Active
notion: The standard good-standing status of a cadet in full compliance with academy regulations, entitled to all instructional privileges and leave permits.
impact: From this state, if an infraction is registered, the cadet can transition to Under Observation or directly to Sanctioned.

name: In Good Standing
notion: The verified regular disciplinary status of an academy student without outstanding demerit points or unresolved infractions.
impact: From this state, the student enjoys weekend leave passes, leadership appointments, and full participation in extracurricular clubs.
